description: Search domains rather than scans with SMQL domain filters, including domains ScanMalware never scanned, each with its newest public scan when one exists. Filters: ct_ip:<ip or /24> (domains on an address when their certificates were issued), nameserver:<exact host> (registered domains delegated to it, optionally AND tld:se), ct_domain:/ct_san: (certificate hostnames, wildcards allowed; add AND ct_issued:last7d to make a wildcard much faster) and tld:. A wildcard over every certificate log runs for a minute or more: the answer then has status 'running', and repeating the same query later returns the result. Paginated by limit (1 to 500) and next_cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.
